scope: Six exact capsule/tool pairs previously implicated at120Hz only. Scan signed distances during manipulation, inspect convex halfspaces within+/-0.15s of each own worst contact. Absence here is not a global collision-validity proof.
method: Normalized convex hull halfspace segment clipping; erosion(radius+10nm) proves full radius ball burial. A segment may cross a local thin or corner region without fitting a full ball. Entry/exit closest-normal comparison is descriptive, not proof of biological compression or complete trajectory topology.

global_monitor_context.interpretation: Existing monitor active is a contact-policy category, not necessarily an attached fruit. Global maximum must not be attributed to these six capsule pairs or the first event without a matching witness.
